title: The Boundedness Problem for Generalized Hilbert Operators on Hardy Spaces
summary: Let $g$ be analytic in the unit disc and consider the generalized Hilbert operator $$ \mathcal{H}_g(f)(z)=\int_0^1 f(t)g'(tz)\, dt. $$ The boundedness of $\mathcal H_g$ on $H^p$ is characterized by the mean Lipschitz condition $g\inΛ\left(p,\frac{1}{p}\right)$ when $1<p\leq2$, while the problem remains open for $2<p<\infty$. It has been recently proved that the condition $g\inΛ\left(p,\frac{1}{p}\right)$ does not imply the boundedness of $\mathcal H_g$ on $H^p$, $2<p<\infty$ \cite{GuoTang2026}.
